Payloads of Shikiru's MCP server at the branch `s1-structured-escalation-view` (tool results as
`structuredContent`), recorded by calling the real tools in memory on a seeded project.

Two edits by hand: `status.json` has a quota window in `quotas` (the seeded project had none), and
`wait_for_events.json` holds events built with Shikiru's `Event` model (the seeded project had
emitted none).
